candidates.statement: Payment service /v1/authorizations is slow (p95 ~4875ms), causing order's POST payment call to hit ReadTimeout (~2s), which propagates as 502 on order /v1/orders and gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment metrics show 200s at ~10.7/60s but p95 4875ms; traces show transport ReadTimeout on payment. Root cause of payment slowness (internal) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout->order->payment chain failing with transport ReadTimeout on payment while inventory/redis succeed; payment p95 latency ~4875ms exceeds order's ~2s timeout, yielding 502s at order and gateway. Bounded to downstream-latency at payment.
missing_evidence: Payment service internal traces/logs to identify why /v1/authorizations latency is ~4.9s
Payment dependency metrics (db/external) to rule out payment-side resource exhaustion
